hidden.name: Hidden
hidden.text: Enemies that have not found you ignore you. Your next attack deals double damage, then Hidden ends.

evade.name: Evade
evade.text: The next hit against you misses. Removes one stack.

strength.name: Strength
strength.text: Attacks deal this much more damage per hit.

weak.name: Weak
weak.text: Deal 25% less attack damage. Decreases each turn.

vulnerable.name: Vulnerable
vulnerable.text: Take 50% more attack damage. Decreases each turn.

bleed.name: Bleed
bleed.text: Lose this much HP at the start of the turn, then it decreases by 1.

regen.name: Fae Vigor
regen.text: Heals this much at the start of its turn. Ash stops it.

ash_struck.name: Ash-Struck
ash_struck.text: Mountain ash: Fae healing falters. No regeneration, and takes 50% more damage.

rough_hands.name: Rough Hands
rough_hands.text: Gain this much Block whenever you play a Knife card.

vow.name: The Vow
vow.text: Gain this much Block at the start of your turn.
